question: The point on the surface, nearest to the focus of the earthquake, is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **epicentre**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Epicenter:-**

 
 
• **The focus, also known as the hypocenter, is the point within the Earth where an earthquake rupture starts.**
 
• The epicenter is the point on the surface directly above the focus.
 
• Seismic waves radiate in all directions from the focus, but they reach the epicenter first.
 
• This is why the epicenter is often the site of the most severe damage from an earthquake.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61f2967524b4c9842ee7f9dfaf7cb9e8d4cadb14dd5a843e3a9966600e025ac9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hypocentre:-**

 
 
• Hypocentre of an earthquake is the point beneath the Earth's surface where the earthquake rupture begins.
 
• It is also known as the focus of the earthquake.
 
• The hypocentre is the source of the seismic waves that are generated by the earthquake.
